name.ja: MG FIGURERISE 1/8 孫悟空 界王拳Ver.
name.en: MG FIGURERISE 1/8 Son Goku Kaioken Ver.

ja: フジテレビ系列で絶賛放映中の人気のＴＶアニメ「ドラゴンボール改」より
主人公・孫悟空のプラモデル、ファン待望の“界王拳ver.”で登場！
漲るパワー全開の肉体表現！超可動でアクション！
あのシーンの、あのポーズを再現しよう！！
【組み立式プラモデル】（接着剤不要）
【対象年齢】１５才以上
【製品素材】ＰＳ／ＰＥ／ＡＢＳ／合成ゴム
（仕様）
フジテレビ系列にて絶賛放映中の「ドラゴンボール改」に登場する「孫悟空」を界王拳Ver.で商品化。
・対フリーザ戦を再現する衣装と赤い成形色で界王拳Ver.の孫悟空を忠実再現。
・手と顔の表情パーツは各２種付属し、ポーズとともに劇中のアクションシーンを再現可能。
・宙に浮いた状態でポージングできる クリアレッドのディスプレイスタンド付属。
・戦闘時の姿を演出できるマーキングシール付属。

en: From the popular TV anime "Dragon Ball Kai" currently airing on the Fuji TV network.
The plastic model of the main character, Son Goku, is now available as the long-awaited “Kaioken ver.” by fans!
Physical expression with full power! Super moveable and action!
Let's recreate that pose from that scene! !
[Assembly plastic model] (no adhesive required)
[Target age] 15 years old or older
[Product material] PS/PE/ABS/synthetic rubber
(specification)
"Son Goku " who appears in " Dragon Ball Kai" which is currently being aired on Fuji TV series has been commercialized as Kaioken version.
-Faithfully reproduces the Kaioken version of Son Goku with the costume and red molding color that reproduces the battle against Frieza.
- Two types of hand and facial expression parts are included, allowing you to recreate action scenes from the movie along with poses.
- Comes with a clear red display stand that can be posed while floating in the air.
・Comes with MarkingSeal that can be used to create a battle appearance.
*Specifications are scheduled as of late April. Please note that there may be slight changes.
*Images are prototypes (including image images). The actual product may differ slightly from the actual product.
*This product is sold at Hobby Online Shop and Toei Animation Online Shop.
Limited items may be sold at events sponsored by our company in the future.
*Depending on the application status, the deadline may change.
*This product can also be purchased at the "Toei Animation Online Shop".
